description_en: Disables the health check feature for a virtual border router (VBR)
description_zh: 关闭指定边界路由器（VBR）的健康检查
kebab_example: aliyun cbn disable-cen-vbr-health-check --cen-id cen-sjfoejfghhjgghjghkg0000 --vbr-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-instance-id vbr-wz95o9aylj181n50000 --vbr-instance-owner-id 1250123456123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableCenVbrHealthCheck

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the VBR is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: vbr_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VBR belongs.

> This parameter is required if the VBR and the CEN instance belong to different Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。

> 如果VBR实例和云企业网实例不属于同一个账号，本参数必填
parameters.name: vbr_instance_owner_id
